title: London by Train 🚆 Rainy Winter Evening Lofi Window Ride | 5-Minute Chillhop Journey
description:
Settle into a window seat for a cozy train ride through an illustrated London on a rainy winter evening: Big Ben, Tower Bridge, the Shard and St Paul's Cathedral glowing gold, red buses and phone boxes, and warm-lit Georgian terraces in the rain, with mellow chillhop the whole way.

Lofi Train POV: cozy illustrated train-window journeys through the world's cities, set to relaxing chillhop. A new city every day. Sit back, look out the window, and stay as long as you like.

Stylised illustrated artwork; not real footage.
Music: "Downtown" and "Empty Sidewalks" by Purrple Cat (purrplecat.com), licensed under CC BY 4.0 (creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Tracks were trimmed and cross-faded.

#lofi #london #trainride #chillhop #rainyday
